description: Minified version of jsTree v3.0.0-beta3, a jQuery plugin for creating interactive tree views.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new jsTree instance on a DOM element with specified options.

methods.name: reference
methods.description: Returns the jsTree instance associated with a DOM element.

methods.name: get_node
methods.description: Retrieves a node object by ID or DOM element.

methods.name: load_node
methods.description: Loads a node's children asynchronously if needed.

methods.name: redraw
methods.description: Redraws the entire tree or specific nodes.

methods.name: open_node
methods.description: Opens a node to display its children.

methods.name: close_node
methods.description: Closes a node to hide its children.

methods.name: get_text
methods.description: Returns the text label of a node.

methods.name: set_text
methods.description: Sets the text label of a node.
